home.heroHeadline: Real pickup basketball, run right, twice a week.
home.heroDek: Organized full and half-court games for adults 15+ in Riverbank — no chaos, no drama, just consistent, competitive runs with people who show up to play.

valueProps.title: Actually coordinated
valueProps.desc: Attendance and game flow are managed every session — not a free-for-all. Everyone gets real run time.

valueProps.title: All skill levels, real competition
valueProps.desc: From weekend regulars to former high school and college players — full court for those who want it, half court for a lower-impact option.

valueProps.title: Built by players, for players
valueProps.desc: Ten-plus years running open gym in the Central Valley, with no outside program cutting corners on coordination.

groups.name: Full Court Group
groups.desc: Competitive full-court runs for advanced players. Thursday evenings and Sunday mornings.

groups.name: Halfcourt Group
groups.desc: Lower-impact half-court games with the same competitive intensity.

groups.name: Over 45 Group
groups.desc: A run built around veteran players' pace and experience.

groups.name: No Way Shane!
groups.desc: The group that started it all — ask a regular what the name means.
